failure_reason.description: Why the report failed; present only when FAILED

result_payload.description: JSON array of the KPIs once completed; null otherwise

user_id.description: Identifier of the user who requested the report

from.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) Inclusive start of the period

to.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) Inclusive end of the period

requested_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the report was requested

completed_at.description: Format: date-time (ISO 8601 UTC with Z, e.g. 2026-09-29T08:30:00Z) When the report reached COMPLETED or FAILED; null while in progress

download_url.description: Signed download URL valid for 15 minutes; only for a COMPLETED report read by id

kpis.description: The KPIs of a COMPLETED report as a JSON array; omitted when not COMPLETED and in summaries
